title: A retried debit may charge twice
description: The retry path calls the debit again without reading the receipt; on a real card this could charge twice.

evidence.summary: The retry calls debit() before the receipt is read.

claimed_root_cause: The retry does not look up the first attempt's idempotency key.
blockers: A test charge needs the live payment provider's sandbox credential, which is not on this machine.

validation_plan.local: Point the provider client at the sandbox and post one retried payment; the provider's ledger shows one or two charges.
validation_plan.deployment: Replay a failed billing retry with a test account and read the provider's ledger.

remediation.strategy: Reuse the first attempt's idempotency key on the retry.
